00176 int WavInFile::readHeaderBlock () {
00177     char label[5];

00182     if (isAlphaStr (label) == 0) return -1;    // not a valid label
00183     if (strcmp (label, FMTSTR) == 0) {
00184         int nLen, nDump;
00185         memcpy (header.format.fmt, FMTSTR, 4);
00186         fread (&nLen, sizeof (int), 1, fptr);
00187         m_swap32 ((unsigned int&) nLen); // int formatLen;
00188         header.format.formatLen = nLen;
00189         nDump = nLen - (sizeof (header.format) - 8);
00190         if (nDump > 0) {
00191             nLen = sizeof (header.format) - 8;
00192         }
00193         fread (&(header.format.fixed), nLen, 1, fptr);
00194         m_swap16 ((unsigned short&) header.format.fixed); // short int fixed;
00195         m_swap16 ((unsigned short&) header.format.channelNumber); // short int channelNumber;
00196         m_swap32 ((unsigned int&) header.format.sampleRate); // int sampleRate;
00197         m_swap32 ((unsigned int&) header.format.byteRate); // int byteRate;
00198         m_swap16 ((unsigned short&) header.format.bytePerSample); // short int bytePerSample;
00199         m_swap16 ((unsigned short&) header.format.bitsPerSample); // short int bitsPerSample;
00200 
00201         if (nDump > 0) {
00202             fseek (fptr, nDump, SEEK_CUR);
00203         }
00204         return 0;
00205     }
00206     else if (strcmp (label, DATASTR) == 0) {
00207         memcpy (header.data.dataField, DATASTR, 4);

00210         return 1;

00213         uint len, i;
00214         uint temp;
00215         fread (&len, sizeof (len), 1, fptr);
00216         for (i = 0; i < len; i ++) {
00217             fread (&temp, 1, 1, fptr);
00218             if (feof (fptr)) return -1;   // unexpected eof
00219         }
00220     }
00221     return 0;
00222 }

00253 void WavOutFile::write (const void *buffer, const int numBytes) {
00254     int res;
00255 
00256     if (header.format.bitsPerSample == 16) {
00257         unsigned short *pTemp;
00258         pTemp = new unsigned short[numBytes / 2];
00259         memcpy (pTemp, buffer, numBytes);
00260         m_swap16Buffer (pTemp, numBytes / 2);
00261 
00262         res = fwrite (pTemp, 1, numBytes, fptr);
00263 
00264         delete[] pTemp;
00265     }
00266     else if (header.format.bitsPerSample == 8) {
00267         res = fwrite (buffer, 1, numBytes, fptr);
00268     }
00269     else {
00270         throw std::runtime_error 
00271             ("unsupported enconding requested for writing");
00272     }
00273 
00274     if (res != numBytes) {
00275         throw std::runtime_error ("error while writing to a wav file");
00276     }
